cards.text: Friend, meet John the Baptist, the man who's been baptizing with water at Bethany beyond the Jordan (John 1:28). The day before, he testified that he saw the Spirit come down from heaven like a dove and rest on Jesus (John 1:29, 32). Now it's the next day, John is there again with two of his disciples, and here comes Jesus, just walking by.

cards.question: As Jesus walks by, what does John the Baptist say about Him?

answers.text: Look at the Lamb of God
Look at the Lion of Judah
Look at the Son of David

cards.question: When John's two disciples hear him call Jesus the Lamb of God, they stay right where they are with John.

cards.text: So now two guys are walking right behind Jesus, and Jesus turns and sees them following. You KNOW that moment, friend, when somebody turns around and you have to act like you were headed that way anyway.

cards.question: Jesus asks the two followers, "What do you want?" They call Him "Rabbi" (which means Teacher) and ask Him something back. What do they ask?

cards.text: "Come and see," Jesus replies. No address, no directions, no pin dropped in the group chat, just COME.

cards.question: The two followers end up spending that day with Jesus.

cards.text: It was about the tenth hour. And one of those two followers has a name: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

cards.question: The first person Andrew goes and finds is his brother Simon.

cards.text: Andrew tells Simon, "We have found the Messiah" (which is translated as Christ). Friend, the biggest news back in that junk drawer I used to live in was a dead battery swearing it still had a little charge.

cards.question: Andrew tells his brother Simon they've found the Messiah. What does Andrew do next?

answers.text: Takes Simon to John the Baptist

cards.text: Jesus looks at Simon and says, "You are Simon son of John." That's a different John, friend, not John the Baptist.

cards.question: Jesus tells Simon son of John he will be called by a new name. What is it?

cards.text: Cephas, which is translated as Peter. Friend, it takes a new coworker a whole WEEK to earn a nickname, and Simon gets a brand new name the moment Jesus looks at him.
The next day, Jesus decides to set out for Galilee. And He finds a man named Philip.

cards.question: When Jesus finds Philip, He tells Philip to ___ Him.

cards.text: Philip is from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter. Then Philip goes and finds a man named Nathanael.

cards.question: Philip tells Nathanael they've found the One Moses wrote about in the Law.

cards.text: Philip adds that He's the One the prophets foretold. His name? Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

cards.question: When Nathanael hears that Jesus is from Nazareth, what does he ask?

answers.text: Can anything good come from Nazareth
Where in the world is Nazareth

cards.text: "Come and see," Philip says, the same words Jesus used with the first two followers. Then, as Nathanael walks up, Jesus sees him coming and says something about him.

cards.question: Jesus says Nathanael is a true Israelite with no deceit in him.

cards.text: I bet Nathanael's jaw hits the FLOOR. He asks, "How do You know me?"

cards.question: Jesus tells Nathanael He saw him before Philip ever called him. Where was Nathanael?
Jesus says He saw Nathanael under the fig tree before Philip called him. How does Nathanael answer?

answers.text: He calls Jesus the Son of God
He says Philip must have told Him
He asks Jesus for a bigger sign

cards.text: Nathanael tells Jesus, "You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!" Friend, he went from doubting to ALL IN faster than my oven preheats.

cards.question: After asking Nathanael, "Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree?" Jesus says the fig tree is the biggest thing Nathanael will ever see.

cards.text: Jesus tells him, "You will see greater things than these." Baker, the fig tree was just the TRAILER.

cards.question: Then Jesus says they will all see heaven open. What will they see ascending and descending on the Son of Man?
